Subvenīte!

imperative of <span lang="la">subveniō</span>, with the dative of the one helped; singular <span lang="la">subvenī</span>

help! (to several)

In this lexicon

  • help!

    the recommended word · classical · Plaut. Men. 1000: Epidamniēnsēs, subvenīte, cīvēs.

Examples

  • quō rapitis mē? quō fertis mē? periī, opsecrō vestram fidem, Epidamniēnsēs, subvenīte, cīvēs.

    Where are you dragging me? where are you carrying me? I’m done for! I beg your help, people of Epidamnus: help, citizens!Plaut. Men. 999–1000

    In the entry for help!

    Help, citizens of Thebes!Plaut. Amph. 376
